messages:
alex: Quick sync — prepping the model catalog launch checklist. We have three open models queued (ozark-3b, fenrir-6b-lite, orchid-13b). Need: licensing sign-off, perf profiles for our standard inference workloads, docs + quickstart, and the registry CR merged. Canary target: start Mon 03/29. Who can pick up which item? :spiral_calendar:
tina: Product here — gating criteria for canary: (1) licensing confirmed, (2) perf within 1.2x of baseline for our 512-token chat profile, (3) docs + example integration. If any are missing, we delay canary. Please flag risks by EOD Fri.
renee: @alex I can take licensing for ozark-3b and orchid-13b. fenrir-6b-lite looks like a special-case license (non-commercial clauses) — need legal intake form + original model license file. Can someone drop the license link here?
sam: I’ll own docs/quickstarts. I’ll add a small notebook and update the API example. ETA: Tue EOD for draft.
eli: Blocking infra note — registry CR #4523 needs a small change to the metadata schema (add "quant_profile" field) before we can ingest new quantized variants. I can do the change but need an approver from eng-ml for the schema contract. @alex can you review?
alex: Thanks. I’ll review #4523 today. @renee I uploaded the fenrir license snapshot to  https://redwood-internal/oss-licenses/fenrir-6b-lite/LICENSE.txt — please check.
renee: Got it, checking now. Quick heads-up: fenrir has an attribution clause that may require a notice in the quickstart. If so, sam — can you slot that into the notebook?
sam: Yep, will add an attribution cell and a short blurb.
eli: For perf owners: we need two profiles — chat-512 (latency-sensitive) and batch-2048 (throughput). I can run baseline infra perf for both but I need the model artifact ACL and exact model name in registry. Which variant should I pull (fp16 vs q4_0)?
alex: Start with fp16 for baseline, then q4_0 for the cost profile. We expect fp16 latency ~1.0x baseline, q4_0 ~1.1-1.3x but much cheaper.
sam: Quick question on docs pathing — will examples reference the hosted Redwood API or dedicated deployment? Product prefers hosted for initial docs.
tina: Hosted for public quickstarts. We'll add a note for Dedicated customers later.
eli: Running perf locally — use this command (Dev infra):
```bash
python perf/run_profile.py --model registry://open/ozark-3b/fp16 --profile chat-512 --out perf/ozark-chat.json
```
Share the perf artifact in the thread when done.
alex: Small code-review ping: CRs blocking launch: #4510 (catalog UI), #4523 (registry schema), #4532 (perf harness). Please drop approvals or feedback.
renee: Legal ETA: I should have formal sign-off for ozark & orchid by Fri noon. fenrir needs a quick product/legal discussion — can we move that to a short async thread?
alex: Sure — create a thread and @tina @renee @sam.
eli: One more infra note — rollout script needs a small env var change: set REDWOOD_CATALOG_PREVIEW=true for canary. I'll add it to #4523.
sam: I'll update the quickstart to include the attribution and a short note about known perf differences for q4_0.
tina: Can someone own the final gating checklist doc (single source of truth) so we don't have multiple places? I can host it in product if someone populates it.
alex: I'll own the gating checklist doc and link it in the release board. I'll add an owners table with clear follow-ups: licensing -> renee, docs -> sam, infra/schema -> eli, perf runs -> eli + alex, CR approvals -> everyone.
deploy-bot: Note: maintenance window Mon 03/29 02:00-04:00 UTC — scheduled infra rollout may be affected.
eli: Acknowledged — will avoid heavy infra ops during that window.
alex: Ok team — action items recap: renee: legal sign-offs (ozark/orchid now; fenrir follow-up), eli: schema change + perf runs, sam: docs + attribution, alex: review CRs + gating checklist, everyone: review CRs #4510/#4523/#4532. Flag blockers ASAP. :thumbsup:
tina: Thanks — I’ll update product roadmap to reflect the Monday canary tentative date.
renee: On it, will post final legal note here when done.
sam: Draft docs link: https://redwood-internal/docs/drafts/model-catalog/curation-quickstart.md — comments welcome.
alex: Thanks all — closing the thread for now, will re-open if any blocker surfaces.
